title: The Vanishing Aurora Diamond
incident_description: At 8:00 PM, curator Dr. Mira Sen displayed the priceless Aurora Diamond in a locked glass display case at Northbridge Museum. At 8:20 PM, the museum experienced a power failure lasting until 8:24 PM. At 8:30 PM, the diamond was discovered missing. The glass case remained completely intact with no obvious signs of forced entry. The electronic lock has battery backup and continued recording authorized-card access events during the power failure. The exact moment of physical extraction is not directly established.
central_questions: Who removed the Aurora Diamond from the display case?
How was the case unlocked during the blackout?
Did the person whose access card was recorded personally operate the lock?
Which evidence is direct and which is circumstantial?
What missing forensic evidence must be collected before reaching certainty?
investigation_rules: Motive does not equal proof of guilt.
Access-card usage records card events, not human identity.
Consider all suspects impartially using identical standards.
Final authority rests with the human judicial reviewer.

timeline.event: Dr. Mira Sen confirms the Aurora Diamond is secured in the display case and locks it.
timeline.notes: Verified locked prior to public gala.

timeline.event: Arjun Vale's access card opens the museum archive.
timeline.notes: Records card swipe at archive door.

timeline.event: Theo Park is continuously shown speaking on stage in the auditorium camera feed.
timeline.notes: Continuous uninterrupted visual recording covers entire theft window.

timeline.event: Lena Ortiz enters the basement following a generator warning alarm.
timeline.notes: Badge log confirms entry; she crossed a wet courtyard earlier.
Emergency battery backup remained active for electronic locks.

timeline.event: Arjun Vale's access card opens the Aurora Diamond display case.
timeline.notes: CRITICAL ACCESS EVENT. Proves card was used; does not prove human identity.
Lighting and main systems come back online.

timeline.event: Security camera records Arjun Vale exiting the archive carrying a flat catalogue folder.
timeline.notes: Silhouette clear, but folder interior is obscured.

timeline.event: Dr. Mira Sen discovers the Aurora Diamond is missing from the display case.
timeline.notes: Case glass unbroken; alarm sounded upon manual check.

suspects.name: Lena Ortiz
suspects.motive: Denied promotion and bonus last month.
suspects.statement: She states she went to the basement to inspect the emergency generator from 8:19 PM to 8:26 PM after an alarm.
relevant_evidence: Muddy shoeprint near display matches her boot size
supporting_evidence: Badge swipe logs confirm basement presence at 8:19 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Muddy shoeprint matching her footwear found near display case.
suspects.uncertainty: She crossed the wet courtyard during earlier exterior door inspection; print timing is unproven.
open_questions: Could another staff member wearing standard issue maintenance boots have made the print?

suspects.name: Theo Park
suspects.motive: Seeking publicity and attention for his upcoming book tour.
suspects.statement: He states he was on stage delivering his address and never stepped near the gallery.
relevant_evidence: Auditorium camera continuously records him from 8:15 PM to 8:29 PM
supporting_evidence: Continuous unedited video footage places him on stage throughout the theft window.
suspicious_evidence: Expressed frustration earlier regarding museum guest attendance.
suspects.uncertainty: Video alibi is strong unless an accomplice was operating on his behalf.
open_questions: Are there any camera blind spots during his speech?

suspects.name: Arjun Vale
suspects.statement: He claims he was working inside the archive and that his access card remained in his jacket hanging inside the archive.
relevant_evidence: Access card opened archive at 8:12 PM
Access card opened display case at 8:23 PM
Seen leaving archive at 8:25 PM carrying flat folder
Blue velvet fibers found inside folder
supporting_evidence: Verified presence in archive corridor at 8:12 PM and 8:25 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Keycard logged opening the display case at 8:23 PM during blackout.
Statement conflicts with electronic lock log.
Fibers matching display cushion found in his folder.
suspects.uncertainty: Card usage does not prove Arjun personally operated it. Folder contents were not filmed. Fibers require spectrometry.
open_questions: Who physically held the card at 8:23 PM?
Could someone else have removed the card from his jacket?

suspects.name: Sofia Reed
suspects.motive: Eager for a sensational career-defining exposé on museum security flaws.
suspects.statement: She states she was conducting interviews in the museum lobby during the blackout.
relevant_evidence: Three museum guests confirm speaking with her during the blackout
Audio recorder active intermittently in lobby
supporting_evidence: Three independent witnesses corroborate her lobby presence.
suspicious_evidence: Wrote articles investigating security flaws at other institutions.
suspects.uncertainty: Her audio recording was paused between interviews, leaving brief unrecorded gaps.
open_questions: Did she leave the lobby at any point between 8:20 and 8:24 PM?

witnesses.name: Dr. Mira Sen
witnesses.statement: Confirmed diamond was secured at 8:00 PM and discovered it missing at 8:30 PM. Stated case was undamaged.
supporting_information: Electronic lock verification log at 8:00 PM.
witnesses.limitations: Did not see who opened the case during the blackout.

witnesses.name: Marcus Vance
witnesses.statement: Monitored the lobby perimeter during blackout. Noticed Sofia Reed talking to guests.
witnesses.limitations: Could not see into the Grand Rotunda due to blackout.

witnesses.name: Clara Higgins
witnesses.statement: Remembered speaking to Sofia Reed about museum art pieces right as the lights went out.
witnesses.limitations: Lost sight of Sofia after emergency lights flickered.

witnesses.name: David Ross
witnesses.statement: Operated the auditorium camera recording Theo Park's speech.
witnesses.limitations: Has no knowledge of gallery operations.

witnesses.name: Elena Rostova
witnesses.statement: Confirmed the display cushion fabric is custom dyed blue velvet.
supporting_information: Provided fabric sample for microscopic reference.
witnesses.limitations: Has not yet performed chemical dye spectrometry.

evidence.title: Electronic Lock Technical Specification
evidence.description: Manufacturer specification confirms internal battery backup keeps memory audit active during power failures.
evidence.establishes: Authorized-card access events continue to be recorded accurately during blackouts.
evidence.does_not_establish: Which human being physically presented the access card to the sensor.

evidence.title: Display Case Access Log (8:23 PM)
evidence.description: Tamper-evident audit log shows Arjun Vale's access card opened the display case at 8:23 PM.
evidence.establishes: Arjun's registered card opened the lock during the blackout at 8:23 PM.
evidence.does_not_establish: That Arjun Vale personally held and swiped the card.
evidence.reliability_notes: Hardware cryptographic timestamp verified by facility engineers.

evidence.title: Arjun Vale's Statement
evidence.description: Arjun claims he was working in the archive and his card remained in his jacket inside the archive.
evidence.does_not_establish: That his card remained untouched or that he stayed in the archive.

evidence.title: Corridor Camera Footage (8:25 PM)
evidence.description: Surveillance camera records Arjun leaving the archive carrying a flat catalogue folder at 8:25 PM.
evidence.establishes: Arjun was physically carrying a flat folder at 8:25 PM.
evidence.does_not_establish: What was inside the folder. Does not establish the diamond was inside.

evidence.title: Blue Velvet Fibers in Folder
evidence.description: Microscopic examination detected microscopic blue velvet fibers inside Arjun's folder.
evidence.establishes: Material similarity to the velvet display cushion in the rotunda.
evidence.does_not_establish: That the diamond was in the folder, or that the fibers came from the cushion without spectrometry.
evidence.reliability_notes: Visual match under stereomicroscope; spectrometry required.

evidence.title: Muddy Shoeprint Near Display
evidence.description: A single muddy bootprint near the display case matches Lena Ortiz's boot size (EU 39).
evidence.establishes: A boot of size EU 39 deposited mud near the display area.
evidence.does_not_establish: When the print was deposited, or that Lena entered during the blackout.
evidence.reliability_notes: Standard museum maintenance boot tread; Lena crossed wet courtyard earlier.

evidence.title: Museum Insurance Policy Schedule
evidence.description: Commercial insurance policy pays indemnity directly to museum trustees, not any employee.
evidence.establishes: No individual employee is designated as a financial beneficiary of the loss.
evidence.does_not_establish: Motive or guilt of any suspect.

evidence_relationships.description: Lock specification confirms E-B log validity during power outage.
8:23 PM lock record contradicts Arjun's claim that card stayed in jacket.
Folder carried at 8:25 PM contained blue velvet fibers matching display.
Shoeprint suggests Lena, but is explained by earlier wet courtyard crossing.

hidden_solution.provisional_assessment: Arjun Vale took advantage of the 8:20 PM blackout, used his access card at 8:23 PM to open the display case, concealed the diamond inside his flat catalogue folder, and exited the archive at 8:25 PM.
decisive_evidence: E-D (Archive departure with folder at 8:25 PM)
preserved_uncertainties: Card use does not establish that Arjun personally held the card.
Corridor footage does not show diamond inside folder.
hidden_solution.alternative_explanation: An associate or insider accessed Arjun's jacket in the archive and used his card to frame him or stage the theft.
